name: Kurumadani Non
source:
[b]S-class Slacker[/b]

Occupation: College student/Consultant
Height: Short
Breast Size: Big

A resident at Yuunagi-sou, Non cuts an unlikely figure - [url=/c112365]the landlady[/url] deems her an "S-Rank Slacker." Though only a sophomore, her stratospheric intellect sees her moonlighting as a consultant to the global political and financial elite.

Yet, for all her razor-sharp insights, Non is hopelessly languid regarding anything requiring focused effort or discipline in her daily life. She couldn't help but wish for someone to manage the mundane essentials on her behalf. Not just anyone would do, of course. That's when she crossed paths with [url=/c112508] our protagonist[/url].

「Need someone to look after me, or I'll inevitably crumble」
